subject: The tree carries status drift that no check looks for
recordedOccasion: from a conformance sweep run at the owner's direction before any retrofit.
severity: F1 is high — an `unclaimed` bundle is meant to be closed to every session and one is not. F5 is high for a different reason: it is a defect in the instrument, and acting on the instrument's raw output would touch sixty-five records that are correct.
feltAt: `0001` F1; `0030`, `0035`, `0036`; eleven bundles resolved before Revision 162's conversion
scope: session management. The remedy is a check and a retrofit, and the retrofit waits on `docs/architecture/state-as-data.md`
read: every `findings.md`, `decisions.md`, `resolutions.md` and `STATUS-` tag in the four trees — 45 bundles, 131 findings
`docs/legend.md`, the ladder and the two permission tables

findings.statement: Releasing a bundle to `unclaimed` leaves its findings where they were, so a bundle closed to every session holds a readable finding
findings.sectionHeading: F1 — an `unclaimed` bundle holding a live finding

findings.statement: Six `accepted` decisions never moved their finding out of `framing`
findings.sectionHeading: F2 — six decisions that moved nothing

findings.statement: Three bundles carry resolutions for findings that are not resolved
findings.sectionHeading: F3 — resolutions for findings that are not resolved

findings.statement: Eleven `resolved` bundles have no `decisions.md`, and whether they owe one has never been decided
findings.sectionHeading: F4 — eleven resolved bundles with no `decisions.md`

findings.statement: A conformance sweep that does not know about superseding clones reports sixty-five false positives
findings.sectionHeading: F5 — the sweep is wrong before it is right

findings.statement: A guard fails where a checker only reports, and the discipline that exists for checkers — a clean pass before it is trusted — has never been stated for guards
findings.sectionHeading: F6 — the discipline exists for checkers and has never been stated for guards

findings.statement: `plan_findings_work.py:439` treats `transferred` as `unclaimed` and reports a permitted transfer as a conformance failure, the last executable site of a rule the documents retired
findings.sectionHeading: F7 — a check refuses an operation the instruction set permits

findings.statement: `plan_findings_work.py` validates decision outcomes against a set the legend replaced: it accepts the retired `superseded → DX` and rejects four outcomes the legend defines
findings.sectionHeading: F8 — the outcome check enforces a vocabulary the legend replaced

decisions.decision: The migrated-bundle carve-out is restored to §3: a bundle migrated from an already-closed record carries `resolutions.md` and no `decisions.md`, and says so. This is `0037` D2, taken once and recorded in both bundles
decisions.sectionHeading: D1 — the ten owe nothing, and the rule says so again

edges.why: a bundle whose release left its findings behind, and a session whose work its state cannot show, are the same gap seen from either end
